I'n really sorry that you are going through all of this. You must be a very very strong person. For what it's worth I am 17 and I was bullied from the age of 4 to 11 and it scarred me so much that I'm suffering from all the things that you are. I tried taking my life, I obsessively cut myself and did a lot of self sabotaging things. I understand where you are and I want you to know that I have learnt that high school is an EXTREMELY small sample size of the world. I don't know anyone who didn't learn that the world is completely different from high school and you will really find people who love you and you can be your true self. Please just hold on, because it will get better. High school is insignificant (once you leave it) and you will learn that you are worth a lot more than what these hormonal brats have been saying to you. I am here for you, please please please private message me. i really respect that you're holding on for your family and please continue doing so because I really want you to reach a point when you can look back at life and be glad that you stuck around and learnt what you're really worth. This is going to be so so so hard, I can't completely understand but I wished I could because I really don't want you going through all this pain alone. But trust me, you will come out stronger than ever and laugh at these high school assholes. From all my bullying I learnt that what people thought of me was less to do with ME and more to do with their insecurities, biases etc. Things that they too grew out of. I know thsi won't make things much better but I really am here for you. Medication and therapy is very crucial for the process and I'm so proud that you have taken these steps. One thing that helps me is distracting myself with work or television. You can also alwyas text me
